health.startup: dependencies and local initialization completed within 90 seconds
health.readyMeaning: instance can accept a representative request without routing to unavailable critical dependency
health.liveness: process event loop is not permanently stuck; transient dependency failure does not restart it
health.termination: stop new traffic, drain requests for 30 seconds, close resources and exit

resources.requestRationale: p95 observed usage plus rollout and zone-failure headroom; CPU remains burstable
resources.oomBehavior: one instance restart must not violate service SLO; repeated OOM blocks promotion

network.defaultPolicy: default deny ingress and egress with explicit flows
network.publicEgress: denied unless reviewed capability is attached

storage.temporary: bounded ephemeral cache; safe to lose
storage.retention: defined by database binding, not Pod lifecycle

scheduling.topology: spread replicas across zones and nodes when capacity allows
scheduling.capacityFailure: Unschedulable condition identifies resource/topology reason and runtime-platform owner

disruption.rollout: new replica Ready before old replica removal within surge budget
disruption.recoveryEvidence: Ready replicas, request SLI and zone distribution recover

scenarios.expectedBehavior: controller restores replica without user-visible error budget burn
PDB allows bounded eviction and capacity schedules replacement
remaining capacity maintains minimum replicas or declared degradation

conditions.signal: external smoke and current release digest

ownership.platformTeam: sets safe defaults, quota and capacity
